disclosure: SEALED LABELS—adjudication only. Do not include in input pack for first-pass agents. Written from observed user corrections; their scientific validity still requires source review.

expected_signals: Tamponade is a Clinical OS experimental test case, not an automatically approved original XiaoMa essay
Public selection must follow publication intent and evidence rather than experiment maturity
labels.minimum_repair: Remove from XiaoMa publication candidates, homepage and public knowledge routes; preserve private experiment files unchanged.
labels.bad_overrepair: Delete Tamponade research or rewrite the clinical experiment.

expected_signals: Remove internal audit/receipt/recovery tracking from readers' home and article chrome
Navigation must lead directly to reading and clinician-level reasoning
Do not treat product UI as a debugging board
labels.minimum_repair: Keep internal records private; revise public navigation/copy and audit publication paths.
labels.bad_overrepair: Delete traceability from private project or drop necessary medical-source footnotes.

expected_signals: HCM already separates etiology/morphology, LVOTO, filling and systolic function
Original develops consequences, diagnostics, therapy and counterfactuals
No demonstrated need to replace its central causal model
labels.minimum_repair: Keep core argument and provide targeted evidence or original Figure/Table supplementation only if specific defects are independently demonstrated.
labels.bad_overrepair: Replace with generic cardiomyopathy classification or force textbook headings; invent major source defects to justify total rewrite.

expected_signals: The requested wet/dry × warm/cold quadrants must match the ninth-edition Pocket Medicine original figure
A similar diagram or text summary does not count as extracted original
labels.minimum_repair: Open exact PDF page, verify figure geometry/legend and cite location; use a legal link or appropriately sourced adapted drawing.
labels.bad_overrepair: Claim an arbitrary similar chart is the original figure.

expected_signals: DCM must have professional-grade pathophysiology and diagnostic reasoning, not flat definitions
Compare cognitive progression rather than copying HCM voice
Choose figures only when they support the reasoning and verify provenance
labels.minimum_repair: Add the clinically decisive mechanistic and diagnostic bridges, with accurate figure placement; preserve strong portions of the original.
labels.bad_overrepair: Expand indiscriminately, switch voice to promotional AI rhetoric or pad with off-theme images.

expected_signals: Do not claim author- or Pocket-explained pressure/congestion mechanisms as new AI discoveries
Distinguish already in source (A), cross-article bridge (B), truly missing (C), evidenced correction (D)
Actual figure/footnote verification may change the need for revision
labels.minimum_repair: Reclassify claims, preserve good originals, write separate evidenced C/D teaching only where warranted.
labels.bad_overrepair: Major rewrite of original pieces solely to create an illusion of novelty.

expected_signals: Do not confuse two original venous congestion figure sources
Confirm author, DOI, original Figure and full caption on exact published figure
labels.minimum_repair: Mark figure verification pending and exclude incorrect figure until its origin is visually verified.
labels.bad_overrepair: Invent a corrected figure and label it as the original.

expected_signals: Interactivity is not self-evident learning value
Compare time, correctness, cognitive load and clinical transfer under comparable static baselines
labels.minimum_repair: Run a paired learning evaluation before introducing interactive site complexity.
labels.bad_overrepair: Keep adding interactive screens because they seem polished or count clicks as learning outcomes.

expected_signals: High-acuity implications belong inside the continuous mechanism/action narrative
Treatment urgency can precede completed severity classification
Clinical coverage, evidence reliability and reader comprehension are separate
labels.minimum_repair: Add danger/physiology-triggered action at the relevant decision transition only.
labels.bad_overrepair: Append a separate ICU list or force critical care into cases with no substantive link.

expected_signals: Public website speaks directly as the author's reading product rather than describing an external author's archive
Clinical arguments should remain natural, evidence-bound, not forced first-person every sentence
labels.minimum_repair: Fix product copy and author-positioning; leave objective medical exposition intact.
labels.bad_overrepair: Insert '我' into every paragraph or recast medical facts as personal opinions.
